summary: TFS Financial Corporation, via Form 8-K on August 27, 2026, declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.3175 per share, payable September 23, 2026 to shareholders of record September 9, 2026. The mutual holding company MHC, owning 81% (227,119,132 shares), waived its dividend rights, having secured member approval and Federal Reserve non-objection to waive up to $1.27 per share through July 7, 2027. Prior waivers totaled $1.13 per share through June 2026. This waiver concentrates dividend payments to minority shareholders, effectively increasing their yield. Watch for continued MHC dividend waivers and potential implications for mutual-to-stock conversion plans.
